title: Gajwan Sarbat
description: Gajwan Sarbat (Sharbat-e-Gaozaban) is a traditional Unani formulation made from Gaozaban (Borage/Onosma bracteatum), highly regarded as a nerve and cardiac tonic. This classical formulation calms the nervous system. Reduces stress and anxiety. Relieves heart palpitations. Helps mental fatigue.
dosage: 20–30 ml mixed with water or a cup of warm herbal tea
